reason: A browser UI plugin that provides a draggable side chat panel for standalone or context-forked conversations, with session persistence, saving, and navigation into the host interface.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中提供可拖动的侧边聊天面板，用于创建独立或继承当前对话上下文的新会话。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable side chat panel to the DeepSeek Harness web interface for creating standalone conversations or forks with the current conversation context.

capabilities: Opens a draggable side conversation panel in the host web interface
Creates standalone sessions or forks of the current conversation
Persists the active side conversation and panel state in localStorage
Archives unsaved side conversations and can save them as visible session branches
Uses host session, workspace, navigation, and prompt APIs
